name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.rhoExec_eq
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.Valid g),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.rhoExec g)
    (DisequalityDispersion.cutSize (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.outputs g hv)
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.tests g hv))

source.code:
/-- **Correctness of the cut computation.** -/
theorem rhoExec_eq : g.rhoExec = cutSize (g.outputs hv) (g.tests hv) := by
  unfold rhoExec
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨K, _, hK, hc⟩ := exists_min_cut (g.outputs hv) (g.tests hv)
    rw [← hc]
    exact (foldr_min_le _ _ _ _ (g.vecOf hv K) (g.vecOf_mem hv K) (g.isCutB_vecOf hv K hK)).trans
      (g.cutCard_vecOf_le hv K)
  · apply le_foldr_min _ _ _ _ _ (g.cutSize_le_nodes hv)
    intro b _ hb'
    exact (cutSize_le_card_of_isCut _ _ _ ((g.isCutB_iff hv b).mp hb')).trans
      (g.termCut_card_le hv b)
